Amazon OpenSearch Service
Developer Guide
OpenSearch Ingestion provisions and manages. You can use a pipeline to ﬁlter, enrich, transform,
normalize, and aggregate data for downstream analytics and visualization in OpenSearch Service.
For a tutorial that demonstrates how to ingest data into a provisioned OpenSearch Service domain,
see the section called “Tutorial: Ingest data into a domain”.
You'll complete the following steps in this tutorial:.
1. Create a collection.
2. Create a pipeline.
3. Ingest some sample data.
Within the tutorial, you'll create the following resources:
• A collection named ingestion-collection that the pipeline will write to
• A pipeline named ingestion-pipeline-serverless
